text: SELECT a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, ms.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, act.standard_type AS standard_type, act.pchembl_value AS pChEMBL_value FROM activities act INNER JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id INNER JOIN target_dictionary td ON a.tid = td.tid INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno INNER JOIN compound_structures ms ON md.molregno = ms.molregno WHERE act.type = 'IC50' AND act.standard_relation = '=' AND act.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293265' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC, a.chembl_id ASC LIMIT 1000;
